Thailand School Shooting Leaves at Least 8 Dead, Including Gunman

A shooting at a school in Thailand resulted in at least 8 deaths, including the 14-year-old gunman who died by suicide. The victims included six students and two teachers. Police reported that the gunman had previously brought an air gun to school. The Associated Press reported that a 12-year-old girl died after the initial incident, raising the death toll. Relatives began claiming bodies of the deceased. The incident occurred near Bangkok.
